## Figma Design (Dark Mode): Documentation Navigation

**Figma frame:** _Documentation Navigation_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design

> **Design-only issue** — work in Figma, not in code.
> **Depends on:** UI-17 (tokens and theme), UI-19 (cards, badges, and tags), UI-20 (responsive layout grid).

### Context

Grid of documentation cards (Installation, Quickstart, Hooks API, SSR Guide, Error Handling, Contributing, plus others) for discoverability.

### What to design (in Figma)

- Section heading, supporting copy, and documentation-card grid.
- Card treatment for Installation, Quickstart, Hooks API, SSR Guide, Error Handling, Contributing, and additional resources.
- Responsive navigation layout with clear hover and keyboard-focus states.

### Deliverables

- Desktop and mobile documentation-navigation frames with representative card states.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Required documentation destinations are represented in the card grid
- [ ] Cards communicate their destination and affordance clearly
- [ ] Hover and focus treatments meet dark-mode contrast requirements
- [ ] Uses UI-17 tokens, UI-19 components, and UI-20 grid rules
- [ ] Figma frame link is shared for review

### Important rules

- Get assigned before beginning work.
- Work only in the assigned Figma frame.
- Use the shared design system and reusable components; do not use loose styles.
- Dark mode only.
